summary: A law-uniform continuity modulus on extreme product-indicator outputs is false even for the fixed target matrix A=I_3. Explicit measure-one finite-fragment sets E_N give individually bounded uniformly continuous densities p_N with a fixed oscillation >0.00105 across distances 616.143/N ->0. This does not refute QFORM or individual continuity. An exact Choquet mixture theorem replaces the common-modulus transfer: individual extreme continuity plus the common L-infinity bound suffices for continuity of all admissible product-density outputs.
